focus: Second-stage constructive repairs for the verified edge-PML linear-growth obstruction in the alpha=1 2D Maxwell-PML model.

routes.title: Edge compatibility or quotient-space restriction
routes.hypothesis: The original source equations can have a uniformly bounded restricted estimate if the transverse zero-mode projection of the undamped shifted magnetic invariant is excluded.
routes.core_object: For x-edges, the kernel projection of M_x=Q_x+mu*(sigma_x/epsilon_0)*H_x; for y-edges, the analogous M_y projection.
routes.expected_energy_type: Uniformly bounded or non-growing estimate on a restricted data class, likely with a quotient or negative-norm component.
routes.falsification_test: Freeze constant edge coefficients, Fourier transform transversely, and check whether any nonzero transverse mode still has a Jordan block or positive real eigenvalue.

routes.title: Damped shifted-variable MPML repair
routes.hypothesis: Adding positive damping to the shifted magnetic variables in edge layers removes the verified Jordan block and admits a positive Lyapunov functional for the edge zero mode.
routes.core_object: Modified equations M_{x,t}=a_x partial_y E - gamma_x M_x and M_{y,t}=-a_y partial_x E - gamma_y M_y with edge-positive gamma_i.
routes.expected_energy_type: Uniformly bounded energy with cross terms; possible monotone Lyapunov functional for frozen modes.
routes.falsification_test: Construct P>0 such that A^T P + P A <= 0 for the zero-mode matrix A=[[0,1/mu],[0,-gamma]], then test frozen nonzero modes numerically or symbolically.

routes.title: CFS or split-field repaired PML
routes.hypothesis: A CFS/split-field formulation with positive frequency shifts moves the zero-frequency PML pole and removes the free shifted magnetic invariant for arbitrary repaired-model data.
routes.core_object: Split memories with decay rates shifted by positive alpha parameters, so edge memories have lambda+alpha denominators instead of lambda denominators.
routes.expected_energy_type: Positive symmetrizer for frozen Fourier modes, followed by a physical-space energy under constant or controlled variable coefficients.
routes.falsification_test: Write the alpha=1 repaired edge and corner symbol and search for a common positive Lyapunov matrix over relevant frozen frequencies.

routes.title: Corner-first shifted symmetrizer
routes.hypothesis: Since both shifted magnetic variables are damped when sigma_x and sigma_y are positive, constant corners may admit a stronger frozen-mode Lyapunov energy even though edges do not.
routes.core_object: The damped shifted equations for M_x and M_y in constant corner PMLs.
routes.expected_energy_type: Frozen-mode positive Lyapunov energy for symmetric corners, possibly bounded perturbative energy for asymmetric corners.
routes.falsification_test: Perform a frozen Fourier-mode semidefinite search separately for sigma_x=sigma_y and sigma_x != sigma_y.
